name: Tabor
overview: Tabor is primarily known as a significant mountain on the border of the tribe of Issachar, serving as a strategic gathering place for Barak's army as commanded by the LORD (Judges 4:6, 4:12, 4:14; Joshua 19:22). It is also referenced as a location where notable battles occurred, highlighting the valor of those who fought there (Judges 8:18). Additionally, Tabor includes a plain of uncertain location mentioned in 1 Samuel 10:3, and it is identified as a Levitical city within the territory of Zebulun, underscoring its multifaceted role in Israelite geography and history.
